title: Edit a website live
summary: Share a folder from your laptop with nginx, then change the page and see it change, with no rebuild.

tasks.title: It shows the `site` folder from this lab, through a bind mount
tasks.hint: nginx shows the files in `/usr/share/nginx/html`. Share your folder there: `-v "$(pwd)/site":/usr/share/nginx/html`. The left side must be a full path; `$(pwd)` gives the folder you're in. Remove the old container first.

tasks.title: You changed the heading, and the page shows your change
tasks.hint: Open `site/index.html`, change the text inside `<h1>`, save with Ctrl + S, and reload the page. No rebuild, no restart.
